decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its prospects are still uncertain, and keeping an approved prescription product costs little, which favors keeping the option open.

The generic antidepressant capsule faces price pressure from reimbursement contracts, but the approval is a sunk cost and it can run on existing capacity, so it stays until the tender results show its value.
The combination antihypertensive supports adherence and fits the strategy of improved formulations, and one year of results is too little to justify abandoning it.

The bone and joint supplement is only mentioned on the website and is the most easily dropped option, but it fits the pharmacy-exclusive health products strategy and costs little to keep while demand becomes clear.
